name: earshot
description: Let coding agents hear audio: describe, match and find sounds, transcribe a film's soundtrack against its cuts, and make sound effects in code, as a local CLI and MCP server.

skills.name: Describe and Match
skills.description: Describes what an audio file sounds like with calibrated tags and scores how well a text description fits it.

skills.name: Find Moments
skills.description: Finds the best moments inside a long recording for a description and returns them as start and end trims.

skills.name: Film Timeline
skills.description: Produces a listening transcript of a film with events, sections, loudness, beats and sync of sound to picture cuts.

skills.name: Forge Sounds
skills.description: Makes a sound effect in code from a recipe and improves it by listening, scored against real reference recordings.

skills.name: SFX Bank
skills.description: Renders sounds from a shipped bank of 252 effects, aimed at a moment in the picture by duration, apex and pitch.
